description: List the iCloud Mail mailboxes (folders): path, name, special use (inbox, sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive) and, by default, message and unread counts. Use the path (or an alias) as `mailbox` in the other apple_mail_* tools. Needs ICLOUD_USERNAME + ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD (app-specific password), and ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS unless the Apple ID is an @icloud.com/@me.com/@mac.com address.

counts.description: Include total and unread counts (default true; one STATUS request per mailbox, first 50 only).

name: apple_mail_list_mailboxes
title: List iCloud Mail mailboxes
